baseline.method: Known-probe erosion with explicit zero-substrate projection; independent upstream erosion + declared projection

observation_rmse_definition: sqrt(mean((D(reconstruction)-measurements)**2)), all 30 frames and all pixels, Angstrom
threshold_rationale: Actual-truth baseline scaling 0.9*NCC and 1.1*dynamic-range-NRMSE; forward RMSE is 1.1 times independently reproduced standard result, consistent with acquisition noise sigma=3 Angstrom.
